name: Dream Eater

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
traits.text: The dream eater provokes no Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Moth Ward
traits.summary: A creature holding a moth's wing automatically succeeds on saves against Hypnotic Wings.
traits.text: A creature holding a moth's wing automatically succeeds on saving throws against the dream eater's Hypnotic Wings.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs walls and ceilings with no ability check.
traits.text: The dream eater can climb difficult surfaces, ceilings included, without an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Talons attacks, and Devour Dreams too.
actions.text: The dream eater makes two Talons attacks and can use Devour Dreams.

actions.name: Talons
actions.summary: +8, 2d6+4 Slashing; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled on a talon (escape DC 14, two talons) and Restrained.
actions.text: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. A Medium or smaller target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two talons, and is Restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Devour Dreams
actions.summary: DC 16 Cha save by a creature it grips, or an Incapacitated one within 5 ft (Incapacitated ones fail): 4d8 Psychic (half on a success) and on a failure Charisma drops by 1d6; at 0 Charisma the victim stays Incapacitated until a Greater Restoration, Heal or Wish.
actions.text: The dream eater unfurls its tongue and drinks the dreams from a mind. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 16, a creature it is grappling or an Incapacitated creature within 5 feet of it (Incapacitated creatures fail automatically). Failure: 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, and the creature's Charisma score decreases by 1d6. A creature reduced to 0 Charisma this way does not recover lost Charisma on a Long Rest and has the Incapacitated condition until its mind is restored by Greater Restoration, Heal or Wish. Success: half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Hypnotic Wings
bonus_actions.summary: Its wings blaze with rainbow light until its next turn (Bright Light 30 ft, Dim 30 ft more); DC 16 Wis save for everyone in the Bright Light or be Incapacitated with Speed 0.
bonus_actions.text: The dream eater's wings shine with dazzling rainbow colors until the start of its next turn, giving off Bright Light in a 30-foot Emanation and Dim Light for 30 feet beyond. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in the Bright Light. Failure: until the start of the dream eater's next turn, the target has the Incapacitated condition and its Speed is 0.

summary: An owl-bodied horror that grips prey in its talons, dazzles crowds with rainbow wings and drinks away dreams and Charisma; a moth's wing breaks its spell.
